topSignals.title: Eleventh consecutive quiet day for Elcogen and Topsoe, INOCEL's two priority benchmark stacks.
topSignals.text: Elcogen's newsroom still shows the Sept 21 Metrosert cooperation announcement as its latest post (23 days old); Topsoe's most recent SOFC/SOEC-specific item remains the Aug 27 H1 2026 results (48 days old). Direct checks of both newsrooms today found no new product, capacity, or partnership announcement in the 24-48h window. Elcogen News | Topsoe News

topSignals.title: New benchmark-rotation cycle begins (Convion, Hexis, SK ecoplant, Nexceris, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN) plus two cross-company sweeps — all surfaced only recycled or multi-year-old stories, no new datapoints.
topSignals.text: Three items worth flagging as false positives from today's search noise: a "SolydEra and Convion" strategic-partnership release is confirmed dated September 2023; a FuelCell Energy–Inuverse (Daegu, South Korea) 100 MW MOU is confirmed July 2025; and a FuelCell Energy–SDC (Sustainable Development Capital) up-to-450 MW global LOI is confirmed January 2026 — all three pre-date this monitor's coverage window and are already implicit in the standing AI-datacenter pipeline.

topSignals.title: Nearest dated catalysts: Germany's Netzpaket Bundestag vote (targeted Oct 16, 2 days out) and Bloom Energy's Q3 2026 earnings (Oct 27, 13 days out).
topSignals.text: Germany's KWK-Gesetz cabinet consideration was targeted for today (Oct 14); the government's published cabinet-results feed does not yet reflect an outcome (the most recent published session, Oct 7, did not include it) — worth re-checking tomorrow once/if today's session results are posted. PJM's 6 GW FERC backstop-auction refiling remains unresolved.

items.text: Elcogen (priority stack):* No new company news in the window. A direct check of elcogen.com/category/news confirms the Sept 21, 2026 Metrosert testing-cooperation announcement remains the latest post (23 days old; full history checked back through the Sept 15 Shanghai HyEnergy item and Aug 31 China Southern Power Grid MoU). No capacity-expansion, product-release, or new partnership announcement found.

Topsoe (priority stack):* No new company news in the window. topsoe.com/news still features the H1 2026 half-year results (DKK ~4.4bn special-items charge, upward 2026 outlook revision) and the Uniper e-methanol FEED contract as the most recent dated items. No new SOEC/SOFC test result, factory milestone, or partnership identified.

Rotating benchmark-company dedicated searches — new cycle, round 1 (Convion, Hexis, SK ecoplant, Nexceris, Huatsing Power, Ningbo SOFCMAN), 7-day lookback:* No new items for any of the six. Results repeated the same already-superseded history flagged in the prior rotation (Convion's 2024 acquisition by HD Korea Shipbuilding & Offshore Engineering; Hexis AG's acquisition by h2e Power; SK ecoplant/Bloom Energy's 500 MW Preferred Distributor Agreement extension, Dec 2023; Nexceris' legacy LEVER/ARPA-E SOEC-scaling program). A "SolydEra and Convion to jointly address growth in fuel-cell and hydrogen market" release also resurfaced in search results today but is confirmed, via direct fetch, dated September 25, 2023 (global strategic partnership combining SolydEra's SOC stacks with Convion's systems; SolydEra capacity cited at the time: 25 MW/yr SOFC + 75 MW/yr SOE at Pergine Valsugana) — not new, and not a 2026 datapoint. No substantive English or Chinese-language news located for Huatsing Power or Ningbo SOFCMAN.

Other key players (Bloom Energy, FuelCell Energy, Ceres Power, Sunfire, SolydEra, Mitsubishi Power, Kyocera, Aisin):* No new stack/cell-technology-specific announcements identified beyond items already logged (financial/market items for Bloom, FCEL and Ceres covered below). A Mitsubishi Heavy Industries 400 kW SOEC test-module item (claiming 3.5 kWh/Nm³ ≈ 101% HHV electrolytic efficiency) resurfaced in a search but is confirmed dated April 2024 (MHI press release 240425) — not new, and the implied ~39 kWh/kg H2 figure would in any case be worse than Elcogen's registered 33 kWh/kg H2 benchmark, so it would not have changed the register even if current.
